description: Angular component for rendering icons with support for SVG, image, and font icons, including external resource handling and dynamic updates.

classes.name: TbIconComponent
classes.description: Angular component for flexible icon rendering with support for SVG, image, and font icons, including external resource management.

methods.name: ngAfterContentInit
methods.description: Initializes icon based on content and sets up observer for content changes.

methods.name: ngAfterViewChecked
methods.description: Checks for path changes to update external references.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and cached references.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Determines icon type and updates rendering accordingly.

methods.name: _updateFontIcon
methods.description: Renders font icon based on name.

methods.name: _setSvgElement
methods.description: Inserts SVG element into DOM and caches external references.

methods.name: _clearSvgElement
methods.description: Removes SVG element and external references.

methods.name: _cacheChildrenWithExternalReferences
methods.description: Caches elements with external resource references.

methods.name: _prependPathToReferences
methods.description: Prepends current path to external resource URLs.

methods.name: _updateImageIcon
methods.description: Fetches and renders image icon, handling SVG data URLs.
